claims.hypothesis: Is there a large quiescent molecular reservoir at ~140 pc?
claims.experiment: Classify CO/Halpha sightlines at 140 pc in eight galaxies
claims.result: Median ~40% CO-only sightlines, ~40% of CO flux without Halpha
claims.finding: Significant quiescent molecular gas not associated with Halpha

evidence.quote: exhibit a significant reservoir of quiescent molecular gas not associated with star formation as traced by Hα emission.

claims.hypothesis: How does overlap depend on resolution?
claims.experiment: Degrade resolution from 140 pc to 1.5 kpc
claims.result: CO-only fraction falls from ~40% to ≲15% at 500 pc; overlap ~75% at 1 kpc
claims.finding: Quiescent gas disappears and morphology washes out at ≳1 kpc

evidence.quote: As we degrade the spatial resolution, the quiescent molecular gas disappears, with the most rapid changes occurring for resolutions up to ∼ 0.5 kpc.

claims.hypothesis: Do global galaxy properties set the star-forming gas fraction?
claims.experiment: Compare fractions to stellar mass, SFR, sSFR

evidence.quote: requires a larger sample size to identify robust correlations between the star-forming molecular gas fraction and global galaxy parameters.

why_this_method.value: Simple, reproducible, threshold-based approach to avoid uncertain CO-to-H2 and Halpha-to-SFR conversions

evidence.quote: We made this choice exactly to minimize the bias due to uncertain conversions between CO and H 2 or Hα and a local star formation rate.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Fixed surface brightness cuts for DIG separation were rejected as less satisfactory

evidence.quote: We experimented with fixed surface brightness cuts to separate the Hα emission into the DIG and the H II regions, but found the resulting masks to be much less satisfactory.

limitations_admitted.value: Fixed CO threshold gives variable completeness, biasing cycling time low; DIG removal and no extinction correction

evidence.quote: A bias against recovering all of the CO emission present affects the inferred f scale, driving the apparent cycling time to artificially low values.

referee_caveats_inferred: Results depend on arbitrary thresholds and DIG filter tuning
